entries.what: Azure AD Graph at graph.windows.net, including tokens requested for that resource.

source.quote: August 31, 2025: End of extended access to Azure AD Graph. Azure AD Graph will be fully retired.

lookFor: A request to graph.windows.net, or a token requested for that resource
requires: Paths, response shapes and app permissions differ, so the token's resource and the app's permissions have to move too.
